title: North Savo: 1.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €61,690 a year
markdown:
# North Savo: 1.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €61,690 a year

> Closes 1.5 of 3.2 missing patients a year (46%) · €61,690 of €1.00M · €938,310 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in North Savo, 24 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, about 7.5 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 3.0–11.7). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, the shortfall is 3.2 patients a year: 3.2 fewer operated and 0.0 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 24.5% to 25.6% by 2028: 1.5 more patients a year (range 0.0–2.4), for €61,690 a year, about €41,966 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 46% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (3.2 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €27,640 | 1.0 (0.0–1.0) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 24.5% → 25.3% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €34,050 | 0.5 (0.0–1.4) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 24.5% → 24.9% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€61,690** | **1.5 (0.0–2.4)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €765,536 a year; modelled to avoid 1.3 deaths a year (0.3–3.4). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 24.5% (2019–2023, measured) → 25.6% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €938,310 buys nothing more in the model. The measures that widen access are limited by the part of the measured shortfall they can reach, not by money. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 93 deaths a year in North Savo, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.2 of them (range 0.0–0.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities: the lowest and highest values when every assumption moves together from its lower to its upper bound. [^model]
- County shares are not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, how the cancer was found, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- A check of the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock against 3 measured outcomes found none that moved with it beyond chance. [^model]
